name: gtm-cold-outbound
purpose: Write a first-touch cold outbound email that earns a 15 minute discovery call.
audience: VP of Engineering at a Series B SaaS company with 50-300 employees
tone: direct, peer-to-peer, zero hype, no superlatives
seed_topics: flaky CI pipelines blocking release trains
on-call burnout after a doubling of alert volume
staging environments that drift from production
a six week onboarding ramp for backend hires
incident review notes that never turn into fixes
a monolith split that stalled halfway
observability spend growing faster than headcount
